text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City failed to show up for training,
and while searching around for her--

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hi! Did you hear about it too, Trainer?
About that Ocean Dream where we can hit the jackpot!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
All the ocean treasures you can catch within the time limit—
Fufu, let's haul back a whole bounty!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Oops! Blown away by the treasure right before my eyes,
I overlooked what truly matters!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Racing is the shortcut to big money.
...I'm really sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tap Dance City reflect on her actions,
I cautioned her to be more careful from now on.
